# Tests the outcome ratchet in ci.yml leaves alone (#1786).
#
# One test id per line, as `scripts/test_outcome_record.py` names a test:
# `<classname>::<name>`, for example
# `tests.test_store.TestOpen::test_readonly[a]`. Copy the id from the step
# summary as it is. `*` matches any run of characters, so
# `tests.test_store.TestOpen::test_readonly[*]` names every parameter of
# that test; every other character, `[` and `?` included, matches itself.
# A test listed here may be skipped, xfailed or never executed without the
# diff calling it a ratchet violation. Say why on a `#` line above each
# entry; a comment after the id on the same line becomes part of the id,
# which then matches nothing.
